data.name: Aaidun
data.gender_notes: Aaidun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'A'a'd, meaning 'to help' or 'to support'. In Islamic context, Aaidun signifies the one who aids and supports others in times of need, embodying the spirit of compassion and solidarity. The name Aaidun carries the meaning “Helper, Supporter” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aaidun usually hope their child will grow to embody helper, supporter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the concept of helping others and being a pillar of support in times of need.
data.etymology: Aaidun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Helper, Supporter.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aaidun total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
